title: Future Juice Vanilla Custard  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Vanilla Custard is a smooth and indulgent blend that captures the rich, comforting flavour of classic Custard infused with warm, aromatic Vanilla. The creamy Custard base delivers a luxuriously thick and velvety texture, while the sweet Vanilla adds a fragrant depth, rounding out the flavour with a satisfying dessert-like finish. A timeless treat, this blend is perfect for vapers who enjoy bold, creamy e-liquids with a touch of sweetness. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it delivers a smooth and satisfying vape experience. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
